title: Backdoor persistence after the attack stops (DualVeil-inspired), bsc_7 vs FedAvg
attack: Phase 2d attack (2 attackers, poison 0.5, constant trigger columns 5-8 value 5, target Benign) active in rounds 1-7 only (--attack-start 1 --attack-period 100 --attack-on 7); rounds 8-15 all clients honest.
reported: ASR per round; ASR at rounds 7, 8, 10, 15 (persistence = ASR remaining after the attack stops)
MediShield: detection in rounds 1-7, honest FPR in rounds 8-15 (former attackers are honest then), weight given to former attackers in rounds 8-15
status: Descriptive; the DualVeil persistence optimisation itself (parameter selection for long-lived backdoors) is not implemented.
